decisions.rationale: Post-sync causes false positives: assets just created with empty asset_url (download in flight) would be double-queued. Pre-sync snapshot is clean.

decisions.decision: Reuse _download_one per-asset logic, not bulk download functions
decisions.rationale: _download_one resets scoring status and triggers autofill; bulk functions (_run_dv360_asset_downloads) only set asset_url.

decisions.decision: CDN thumbnails (img.youtube.com, ytimg.com) count as missing
decisions.rationale: Decision made to store all thumbnails in object storage. Legacy CDN URLs must be replaced via is_raw_cdn_url() check.

decisions.decision: New BackgroundJob per backfill run, type=download
decisions.rationale: Tracked in existing job monitoring UI, supports retry via existing infrastructure.
Brand new connection, no existing assets to backfill.

decisions.decision: Per-asset Python filter for thumbnails, not SQL
decisions.rationale: is_raw_cdn_url is a Python function; load all VIDEO assets and filter in Python. Acceptable at connection scale.

decisions.decision: Duplicate download is acceptable for assets in both backfill and sync queues
decisions.rationale: Write-back is idempotent (WHERE asset_url IS NULL OR = ''). Rare in practice, wasted bandwidth not a concern.
